name: io.github.anup-shesh/garmin-local-mcp
description: Local-first Garmin data warehouse: sync once to SQLite, analyze trends and correlations offline.

environmentVariables.description: Data directory for the local warehouse (defaults to ~/.garmin-mcp)
environmentVariables.name: GARMIN_MCP_DATA_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Required PostgreSQL connection URL for the local warehouse
environmentVariables.name: GARMIN_MCP_DATABASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Required IANA timezone used for local dates and scheduled syncs
environmentVariables.name: GARMIN_MCP_TIMEZONE

environmentVariables.description: Required comma-separated local sync times in HH:MM format
environmentVariables.name: GARMIN_MCP_SYNC_TIMES
